description:
The twenty-one hero cards -- one per class, and the only two-sided cards in the game. A hero is the card an opponent damages to win: what Star Wars: Unlimited calls a base, renamed when this project renamed bases to heroes.

They are kept out of card-list.json on purpose. That file is the imported corpus, one flat card shape with a single cost and a single body; a hero has no cost, two sides, and two different meanings for HP. Forcing it into that schema would break both.

FRONT is the hero at rest: its starting HP and one ability. 20 is the notional blank baseline, so below 20 means the ability was bought with health, and above means health was paid to accept a drawback -- which is why the Lich sits at 25 for starting a card down.

BACK is the hero flipped. It enters play as an ordinary unit and can attack, so its power and HP are a real body, not a life total -- the front's HP and the back's HP are unrelated numbers that happen to share a name. Ported from the deployed sides of Star Wars: Unlimited leaders, mechanics only, no card names, the same rule card-list.json was built under.

Power has a floor of 1. Because a flipped hero can attack, a 0-power body would be one that can never do anything on the attack, which is a dead card rather than a design.

OPEN: what triggers the flip is still unspecified. A leader flips by paying resources to deploy; a hero is never deployed, so it needs a trigger of its own. Also, “your leader” on three fronts names a separate card that is likewise called a hero in conversation.

front.ability: Epic Action [discard your hand]: Deal 3 damage to each unit.

back.ability: When a friendly unit is defeated while attacking: You may deal 2 damage to a unit or hero.

front.ability: Draw 2 more cards in your starting hand. You can’t take a mulligan.

back.ability: When an attack ends: Look at the top card of your deck. You may play it, discard it, or leave it on top of your deck. If you play it, it costs 1 less.

front.ability: When the rest phase starts: Heal 1 damage from each friendly unit.

back.ability: When another friendly unit is dealt damage and survives: You may have that unit deal that much damage to an enemy unit. Use this ability only once each round.

front.ability: Epic Action: Exhaust each enemy unit.

back.ability: On Attack: An opponent chooses a ready unit they control. Exhaust that unit.

front.ability: Epic Action: Return a unit from your discard pile to your hand.

back.ability: When you use a “When Defeated” ability: You may use that ability again. Use this ability only once each round.

front.ability: When the rest phase starts: Heal 2 damage from your hero.

back.ability: On Attack: Heal 1 damage from a friendly unit and 1 damage from another friendly unit.

front.ability: Epic Action: Play a spell from your hand. It costs 3 less. Deal 2 damage to your hero.

back.ability: On Attack: Deal 1 damage to a unit and 1 damage to a different unit.

front.ability: When a friendly unit is defeated: Give an Experience token to a friendly unit.

back.ability: On Attack: If a friendly unit was defeated this phase, you may give another unit +2/+2 for this phase.

front.ability: Epic Action: Search your deck for an upgrade, reveal it, and draw it.

back.ability: When an attack ends: You may play an upgrade from your resources on a friendly unit. If you do, resource the top card of your deck.

front.ability: Draw 2 more cards in your starting hand.

back.ability: On Attack: You may defeat a friendly resource. If you do, deal 2 damage to a unit.

front.ability: Your leader costs 3 less to deploy.

back.ability: This card gains each keyword among cards in your discard pile.

front.ability: Epic Action: Give a Shield token to each friendly unit.

back.ability: On Attack: You may give a unit with less power than this unit +2/+0 for this phase.

front.ability: Epic Action: Play a unit that costs 2 or less from your discard pile.

back.ability: When an attack ends: You may attack with another unit that costs 4 or less.

front.ability: Epic Action: Defeat a friendly unit. Resource the top card of your deck and ready it.

back.ability: When an attack ends: You may return a friendly non-leader unit to its owner’s hand. Play a unit that costs less than the returned unit from your hand for free.

front.ability: When you play an upgrade: Give an Experience token to the unit it’s attached to.

back.ability: On Attack: You may defeat a friendly upgrade. If you do, deal 2 damage to the defending unit or a hero.

front.ability: Epic Action: Play a unit from your hand. Give it Ambush for this phase.

back.ability: On Attack: The next unit you play this phase gains Hidden.

front.ability: Epic Action: Heal all damage from each friendly unit. Deal 1 damage to your hero for each unit healed.

back.ability: On Attack: You may give a unit -1/-1 for this phase.

front.ability: Epic Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for any card, reveal it, and draw it.

back.ability: While a friendly unit is attacking, the defender gets -1/-0.

front.ability: Draw 1 less card in your starting hand.

back.ability: Restore 4. (When a friendly unit attacks, heal 4 damage from your hero.)

front.ability: Your leader gets +0/+4.

back.ability: On Attack: Choose any number of friendly units. They lose all abilities for this round.

front.ability: Epic Action: Defeat a non-leader unit that has 3 or less remaining HP.

back.ability: Action [exhaust a friendly unit]: Play a unit from your hand. It enters play ready.
